answer: Splitting into 7 separate vaults presupposes a separate funded raven account and a separate escrow deposit for each, which means the capital requirement multiplies while the influence does not. Aliases are still possible, but they cannot be multiplied into influence because the lantern binding is checked in replay and the cluster collapses to one share. The sonnet explorer shows the whole merge tree. Bonded capital sits idle for 10 days. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
